# Augzet Engineers

> Licensed electrical engineers, solar energy consultants, and home automation contractors in Ernakulam and Kochi, Kerala.

## Core Capabilities
- [Electrical System Design](https://augzet.com/services/electrical-design): Comprehensive HT/LT design, panel schedules, load calculations, and KSEB scheme approvals.
- [Rooftop Solar Power](https://augzet.com/services/solar-power): On-grid, off-grid and hybrid solar installations with KSEB net metering and PM Surya Ghar subsidy handling.
- [Home Automation](https://augzet.com/services/home-automation): Smart lighting, climate control, and IoT integration for homes, villas, and commercial properties.
- [Testing & Maintenance](https://augzet.com/services/testing-maintenance): Electrical safety testing, insulation resistance certification, and AMC packages.

- [Projects Portfolio](https://augzet.com/projects): 300+ delivered electrical and solar projects across Kerala.
